# Exploratory Data Analysis: 

# Data Structure:

```{r}

library(data.table)

train <- fread("aluminum_coldRoll_train.csv")

str(train)
summary(train)

```

# Target Distribution: 

```{r}

table(train$y_passXtremeDurability)
prop.table(table(train$y_passXtremeDurability))

```

# Numeric Feature Distributions: 

```{r}

numeric_cols <- c("firstPassRollPressure", "secondPassRollPressure",
                  "contourDefNdx", "clearPassNdx")

for (col in numeric_cols) {
  hist(train[[col]], main = paste("Histogram:", col), xlab = col)
}

```

# Categorical Feature Distributions: 

```{r}

categorical_cols <- c("alloy", "cutTemp", "rollTemp",
                      "topEdgeMicroChipping", "blockSource",
                      "machineRestart")

for (col in categorical_cols) {
  print(col)
  print(table(train[[col]]))
}

```

# Numeric VS Target: 

```{r}

boxplot(firstPassRollPressure ~ y_passXtremeDurability, data=train,
        main="First Pass Pressure vs Outcome")

boxplot(secondPassRollPressure ~ y_passXtremeDurability, data=train,
        main="Second Pass Pressure vs Outcome")

train[, pressure_diff := secondPassRollPressure - firstPassRollPressure]
boxplot(pressure_diff ~ y_passXtremeDurability, data=train,
        main="Pressure Diff vs Outcome")

```

# Categorical VS Target: 

```{r}

# Temperature: 

prop.table(table(train$cutTemp, train$y_passXtremeDurability), 1)

# Alloy:

prop.table(table(substr(train$alloy, 1, 2), train$y_passXtremeDurability), 1)


```

# Correlation Plot: 

```{r}

library(corrplot)

num_only <- train[, sapply(train, is.numeric), with=FALSE]
cor_mat <- cor(num_only, use="pairwise.complete.obs")

corrplot(cor_mat, method="color", tl.cex=0.7)

```

# Checking Missing Values: 

```{r}
colSums(is.na(train))
```
